text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r b-l-o-c-k-e-d r-a-d-i-o f-r-e-q-u-e-n-c-y s-i-g-n-a-l-s u-s-i-n-g a j-a-m-m-e-r u-n-i-t, l-e-f-t a p-h-y-s-i-c-a-l d-e-v-i-c-e a-t t-h-e s-i-t-e, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e l-i-c-e-n-s-e-d s-p-e-c-t-r-u-m c-h-e-c-k.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r i-n-s-t-a-l-l-e-d g-p-s s-p-o-o-f-i-n-g s-o-f-t-w-a-r-e o-n a l-a-p-t-o-p, r-e-c-o-r-d-e-d a n-e-t-w-o-r-k l-o-g s-h-o-w-i-n-g f-a-l-s-e c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-e-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e a-u-t-h-o-r-i-z-a-t-i-o-n v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r r-e-d-i-r-e-c-t-e-d d-r-o-n-e l-a-n-d-i-n-g v-i-a f-a-k-e w-a-y-p-o-i-n-t s-i-g-n-a-l-s, l-e-f-t d-r-o-n-e m-a-i-n-t-e-n-a-n-c-e r-e-c-o-r-d-s w-i-t-h a-l-t-e-r-e-d l-o-c-a-t-i-o-n d-a-t-a, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e r-o-u-t-e i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y a-u-d-i-t.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-o-l-l-e-c-t-e-d d-e-l-i-v-e-r-y p-a-r-c-e-l-s f-r-o-m t-h-e f-a-l-s-e l-a-n-d-i-n-g z-o-n-e, l-e-f-t a r-e-t-u-r-n s-h-i-p l-a-b-e-l a-t t-h-e d-r-o-n-e d-o-c-k, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e p-r-o-p-e-r-t-y i-n-v-e-n-t-o-r-y r-e-p-o-r-t.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-e-l-e-t-e-d l-o-c-a-l l-o-g f-i-l-e-s a-f-t-e-r t-h-e o-p-e-r-a-t-i-o-n, l-e-f-t t-h-e o-r-i-g-i-n-a-l c-o-m-m-a-n-d p-r-o-m-p-t h-i-s-t-o-r-y i-n t-h-e s-y-s-t-e-m, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e i-n-c-i-d-e-n-t n-o-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n p-r-o-t-o-c-o-l.
